source_prompt:
I want you to create a mockup demo code file. Just name the code file as demo1testing1.go. I want you to write a code file that is extremely broken, with missing syntax and intentionally worse, meant to give a lot of errors. Missing syntax, function, and everything. Create this Go file, maybe 200 lines of code, and then I want you to edit it.

Create it, and then after creating it, edit it to remove all the errors and fix it. In order to do that, I want you to tell me honestly, brutally honestly, when you're going to edit it, are you catching all the errors? Do you have self-awareness of all the errors and warnings that you are catching? You don't have to be fully dependent on go build to fix all the errors, because you have direct access to all the errors and warnings. You can fix the code file, right, and be fully sure there are no errors instead of just relying on build commands. Once you do that
